versions.changelog:
pseo-generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a structured, scalable framework for modern programmatic SEO using strict JSON schemas and niche taxonomies.
- Separates content (JSON data) from design (React renderers) for maximum flexibility and validation.
- Includes detailed guides for building taxonomies, JSON schemas, and six content categories (resource, comparison, tool, checklist, guide, template).
- Features quick-start checklist and reference materials for rapid implementation.
- Provides specialized configuration and voice rules for use with Tolstoy’s ecommerce AI brand.
- Shares proven metrics from real-world deployment (13,000+ pages, rapid scale, major click lift).
